verdict.rationale: Discord's interactions docs describe buttons as customizable clickable components and modals as pop-up form interfaces for apps. They also describe message components that let users invoke apps natively in chat, and the Embedded App SDK supports richer interactive experiences inside Discord. missing for 10: explicit documentation of structured message layouts (e.g., layout containers or embeds), deeper detail on component types beyond one-line mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
